classification: Original-gate CDB baseline hardware diagnosis. Not quality or a new architecture.

selection.rule: Filter campaign_partition == calibration. For each dataset in gsm8k,math500, sort id lexicographically and select the first two.

engine.gate: Original checkpoint early_exit_gate. Exact original sigmoid/float/item operation order.
engine.physical_gpu: Main assigns one guarded GPU from 4,5,6,7 before launch and records UUID. This contract launches nothing.

sequence.sampling: Native greedy, temperature zero. Preserve tokenizer EOS and original stop strings. No teacher forcing or allowed-token mask.
sequence.optional_native_warmup4: Existing quality_pilot warmup only. Not a graph-OFF arm and not measured.
sequence.request_wall: Existing request boundary synchronize, perf_counter_ns, native generate_batch, synchronize, end clock. Event export follows the end clock.
sequence.common_clean_observer: Only the existing pilot-style CPU exit-position/depth recorder is common to all arms. No timing wrappers in clean arms.
sequence.graph_requirement: Reject every measured phase with any recurrent or stage graph capture. Require observed graph hits to match actual launches. Do not classify capture time as service.
sequence.failure_policy: Retain all diagnostics. Reject attribution after any output/depth/NFE parity failure, capture, event-pool overflow, unknown stream, hook lifecycle failure, or CUDA failure. No automatic retries.

observation_points.clock: Unique CUDA event pair on inputs_and_outputs.compute_stream
observation_points.scope: One original graph replay: all physical layers, recurrent norm, original gate head, and native hidden_out/exit_signals copies. Excludes outer input staging and hidden-bank scatter. Includes possible host enqueue gaps.
Containing metadata reuse wait, CPU preparation, H2D, hidden gather, graph launch, hidden scatter, and original compute-stream synchronization.
CPU lists and pinned metadata construction only. Nested within recurrent_batch_host. Not isolated H2D time.
Original dispatch plus policy sigmoid, float, item readback, and host CDF update when reached. Forced final-step shortcut is separately labeled. Never change its caller stream.

observation_points.clock: perf_counter_ns for every flush; one unique compute-stream CUDA event pair only when the original backlog is nonempty
observation_points.scope: Whole terminal publication window, including grouping, row-index preparation and all source gathers/destination copies. Not pure copy-kernel busy time. Preserve native stream order before any next recurrent read.
Native coda staging/gather plus graph containing LM head and argmax. Projection versus sampling is not separable with an outer hook.
Containing synchronous coda launch, original stream wait and token readback on this async-OFF path. Overlaps coda_device.
Original host token-list conversion and hidden-slot release. No newly added synchronization.

events.construction: Preallocate and materialize all timing events outside measured phases on the existing compute stream. Synchronize only at the request boundary.
events.recording: Use Event.record(explicit_compute_stream). Do not wrap the original call in a new stream context. Every observed invocation gets a distinct pair.
events.resolution: Read elapsed_time only after the request boundary synchronization. Reuse a pair only after its result was resolved and archived.
forbidden: Reading one last replay then multiplying by count

overhead.metric: Trace request wall divided by the mean of clean-before and clean-after request walls, minus one. Report raw signed value, not corrected service time.
overhead.clean_drift_metric: Absolute clean-after minus clean-before wall divided by their mean.
overhead.preregistered_diagnostic_guard: If clean drift exceeds 5 percent, or trace wall exceeds 105 percent of the larger clean wall, mark observer overhead or drift UNRESOLVED. Keep raw spans but make no quantitative bottleneck claim.
overhead.statistics: One triplet per request. No timing confidence interval or population claim. No overhead subtraction from device intervals.

rules: Retain nested interval IDs and containing request wall
Do not add CPU and CUDA intervals
Do not subtract CUDA span from host wall to label a pure CPU remainder
Do not convert span sums to a 100-percent E2E attribution
No Amdahl speedup claim from these observations
unresolved_separations: Pure exit-policy method wall without dispatch
